description: Captain Marcus Chaplin and XO Sam Kendal refuse an irregular order to launch nuclear missiles at Pakistan, survive an attack by their own navy, and seize the NATO station on Sainte Marina to keep the USS Colorado and its crew alive. Chaplin's nuclear deterrent buys time but turns the island into a pressure cooker: Prosser challenges his command, local strongman Julian Serrat exploits the crisis, China moves in, and Washington pressures the sailors' families while Kylie Sinclair and Christine Kendal uncover evidence of the conspiracy. The standoff ends in mutiny, a battle for the submarine and Chaplin's final decision to keep the Colorado from becoming someone else's weapon.

s01e01.description: The USS Colorado receives an order through a secondary Antarctic channel to launch nuclear missiles at Pakistan, and Captain Marcus Chaplin refuses until the command is authenticated through normal authority. XO Sam Kendal makes the same demand after Chaplin is relieved; the Colorado is then torpedoed by the USS Illinois, survives and reaches Sainte Marina, where Chaplin establishes a nuclear-backed exclusion zone rather than surrender the submarine and crew.

s01e02.description: Foreign and American warships test Chaplin's 200-mile perimeter, and he uses the Colorado's Perseus stealth system to approach the USS Illinois and hit it with a deliberately disabled torpedo as a warning. A special-forces unit is inserted onto Sainte Marina, forcing Sam, Grace and a small ground team into a firefight while Washington pressures Christine to persuade her husband to surrender.

s01e03.description: Prosser is released from the brig to help locate three missing Colorado sailors, only for Chaplin to learn that Serrat has kidnapped them. Serrat forces the submarine to retrieve cargo from outside the naval perimeter; the Colorado returns too late to satisfy him and he kills one hostage, while Kylie and Admiral Shepard trace the original launch order and the Perseus plans disappear from Kylie's apartment.

s01e04.description: With treason charges announced against Chaplin and Sam, the crew is allowed to choose whether to remain with the Colorado. The Defense Department secretly sends individual sailors orders authorizing action against their captain, culminating in Brennan threatening the bridge with a grenade and trying to force the submarine toward surrender; in the United States, Christine faces government pressure while Sam's old friend Paul Wells moves closer to her.

s01e05.description: Secretary of Defense William Curry arrives on Sainte Marina to negotiate directly with Chaplin and Sam, offering terms that would return the Colorado while leaving the officers exposed. At the same time a failed sonar-array battery opens a hole in the island's defense, forcing Grace to command the submarine on a repair mission; when U.S. forces are positioned to sink the Colorado, Admiral Shepard kills Curry and his adviser to stop the firing order.

s01e06.description: Attackers working through Serrat contaminate Sainte Marina's water supply with the military hallucinogen BZ and move against the incapacitated crew. Sam fights through memory gaps and hallucinations with James King to stop the commandos on the island, while Chaplin, Grace and a skeleton crew struggle to keep the Colorado alive at sea; an unidentified person restores the submarine's oxygen and steals one of Chaplin's launch keys.

s01e07.description: Chaplin investigates the BZ attack and the theft of his nuclear launch key, increasing suspicion throughout the crew. Prosser's confrontation with Serrat escalates over the attack and the drug trade among the sailors, while a surviving SEAL tells Sam that a faction in Washington wants Chaplin removed in exchange for amnesty; Christine and Kylie continue building a public case against the government's account of the crisis.

s01e08.description: A Thanksgiving feast intended to reduce hostility between the Colorado crew and Sainte Marina collapses when islander Erita accuses Chief Anders of rape. Grace Shepard defends Anders at a joint island-Navy trial and realizes Serrat has manipulated the jury to provoke unrest; Anders ultimately admits the assault, and Chaplin discharges him and orders him held for prosecution.

s01e09.description: A transport carrying forty relatives of the Colorado crew, including Christine Kendal, is seized by Pakistani commandos who demand that Chaplin fire a nuclear missile at Indian forces entering Pakistan. The original SEAL operation is also exposed: Hopper had been ordered by the Secretary of Defense to plant false evidence of Pakistani suitcase nuclear weapons, tying fabricated intelligence directly to the crisis that produced the Colorado's launch order.

s01e10.description: Sam and James King travel to Manila to recover Christine from the people using her as leverage, while the rescue exposes how far the conspiracy reaches beyond Sainte Marina. On the island, Chinese envoy Zheng offers Chaplin supplies and political recognition in return for influence, and Chaplin must also deal with overcrowded confinement and discipline problems among sailors who have turned to Serrat's drug trade.

s01e11.description: A U.S. Navy destroyer moves to intercept the Chinese supply ship bound for Sainte Marina, forcing Chaplin to defend the aid route without triggering a larger naval battle. In Washington, Kylie brings evidence of the President's Pakistan deception to the Speaker as Admiral Shepard helps organize a coup, while Cortez admits she has been paid by the CIA and refuses an order to kill Chaplin; Serrat separately bargains with China over the island's rare-earth deposits.

s01e12.description: Admiral Shepard tells Chaplin that a Washington coup is imminent and prepares him to surrender the Colorado once the President is removed, while Kylie helps move the evidence needed to justify the takeover. The plan collapses as political support evaporates, and on Sainte Marina Prosser's mutiny advances while the Chinese resupply arrangement becomes another source of division inside the crew.

s01e13.description: Prosser's mutiny is hijacked by men planning to hand the Colorado to China, leaving Chaplin, Sam, Grace and Prosser fighting together to regain control of the submarine. Chaplin retakes the conn and destroys the Colorado rather than allow it to become another government's weapon, sacrificing himself; in Washington, Kylie releases evidence of the President's conspiracy after arranging Christine's return and then shoots the President.
